# Global Innovator Awards 2026

> The UK's first awards programme recognising founders, innovators and exceptional talent who came to the UK under an innovation or talent visa route and are delivering on their ambition. Free to enter, independently judged, ten competitive categories plus the honorary Pioneer Award. Awards evening October 2026 in Central London. Organised by NEXUS Creative HQ Ltd.

## Pages
- [Home](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/): Overview, eligibility, why enter, categories and the awards evening.
- [Categories](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/categories): The 10 competitive categories plus the special Pioneer Award, with descriptions and judging criteria.
- [About](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/about): Why the awards were created, who can apply, the two-stage process, and about NEXUS.
- [Tickets](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/tickets): Awards evening details and the early-bird waitlist.
- [FAQs](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/faqs): Eligibility, entry, key dates, judging, confidentiality, tickets and contact.
- [Contact](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/contact): Enquiry form for sponsorship, partnerships, press, group bookings and general questions.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/terms)
- [Privacy and Cookies](https://globalinnovatorawards.com/privacy)

## Key facts
- Organiser: NEXUS Creative HQ Ltd, trading as NEXUS (company no. 12667243).
- Entry: Free. Both self-nomination and third-party nomination are accepted.
- Eligibility: Founders, innovators and talent who came to the UK on a Global Talent Visa, Innovator Founder Visa, Innovator Visa (closed 2023), Start-up Visa, Tier 1 Exceptional Talent or Tier 1 Entrepreneur route.
- Nominations: Open now, close 15 July 2026. Shortlist announced on or around 20 August 2026.
- Awards evening: October 2026, Central London.
- Nominate: https://zztxkve7k7f.typeform.com/innovatorawards
